column1: # T87: the types_* targets become types_values, types_patterns, types_modules, types_analog, types_carriers and types_generics; the elab_* targets become elab_values, elab_analog, elab_digital and elab_structure; book and spec_codes become modules of spec_structure; one module per former target (the prefix of the old name is dropped; elab_buck is the module buck_converter, because the support module buck of the same target keeps its name).
